entry.title: Anamika Dubey is scheduled to join the panel “AI Infrastructures: It’s Really an Energy Race” at the WTIA AI Summit o...
entry.content: Anamika Dubey is scheduled to join the panel “AI Infrastructures: It’s Really an Energy Race” at the WTIA AI Summit on October 27, 2026, at Bell Harbor International Conference Center in Seattle. The panel will discuss AI infrastructure growth and its implications for energy and the power grid. Summit details.

entry.title: Anamika Dubey helped host AGI Day 2026 at WSU Tri-Cities in Richland, Washington. The theme, “Intelligent Grids at Sc...
entry.content: Anamika Dubey helped host AGI Day 2026 at WSU Tri-Cities in Richland, Washington. The theme, “Intelligent Grids at Scale: Serving rapid demand growth while preserving reliability and affordability,” brought researchers and industry leaders together to discuss AI, data-center load growth, grid resilience, and research deployment. Event details.

entry.title: The lab’s paper “Deep Reinforcement Learning for Distribution System Operations: A Tutorial and Survey” was accepted ...

entry.title: Anamika Dubey helped host AGI Day 2025 at WSU Tri-Cities, focused on building and operating an affordable, reliable, ...
entry.content: Anamika Dubey helped host AGI Day 2025 at WSU Tri-Cities, focused on building and operating an affordable, reliable, and secure regional grid. Discussions covered transmission planning, wildfire resilience, flexible demand, distributed energy resources, and AI for the grid. Recordings and presentations.

entry.title: Anamika Dubey co-organized AGI Day 2024 with Wei Du at WSU Tri-Cities in Richland, Washington. The event explored the...
entry.content: Anamika Dubey co-organized AGI Day 2024 with Wei Du at WSU Tri-Cities in Richland, Washington. The event explored the nexus of power systems engineering and advanced analytics for a resilient, decarbonized grid, bringing together researchers, industry partners, and students for talks, an industry panel, and a student poster session. Event recap.
